apiMessages.content:
All 11 sessions scheduled, Sept 22 – Oct 9.

**Structure:** Upper/Lower split, Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri each full week (week 1 starts today, so only 3 sessions).

| Week | Load target | Sessions |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ~50-55% pre-layoff weight, 3x8/6, no Nordic curls/Ring Dips | Tue 9/22 Lower A, Thu 9/24 Upper B, Fri 9/25 Lower B |
| 2 | ~65-70%, add Nordic Hamstring Curls (2x5) + Ring Dips (3x6) | Mon 9/28 Upper A, Tue 9/29 Lower A, Thu 10/1 Upper B, Fri 10/2 Lower B |
| 3 | ~75-80%, 4-set main lifts, Weighted Pull-Ups back in | Mon 10/5 Upper A, Tue 10/6 Lower A, Thu 10/8 Upper B, Fri 10/9 Lower B |

Added Bench Press, Overhead Press, Deadlift to your library (weren't there before). Weight prescriptions are % of your old working weight since I don't have your actual numbers — plug those in yourself.

Rule for all 3 weeks: stop sets 1-2 reps short of failure, no grinding singles. If week 1 leaves you wrecked past 48hrs, tell me and I'll flatten week 2 instead of progressing it.
Nothing's pending on my end — the 3-week schedule is fully created (11 sessions, Sept 22–Oct 9). What do you want me to continue with?
